component.name: Tablo Watcher
component.summary: Watch and configure recordings on your Tablo DVR

ul.li: A channels-by-time guide grid, with live TV playing in the browser
Your recordings by show, movie and sports event: watch, resume, mark watched, protect or delete them
Search the guide, and set up series recordings or record single airings
See what is scheduled, and sort out conflicts when there aren't enough tuners
Channel details and how the Tablo's storage is being used

description.p: Tablo Watcher is an independent project, not associated with Tablo or Nuvyyo.
